Derivative Algebra on Index Multisets

Source: R/d34e_zero_wrappers.R
zw34_memo.Rd

Small operations on quantities represented as functions of a sorted integer vector S, a multiset of parameter indices, returning the derivative of the quantity along S (one value per observation). zw34_mul() forms the product by Leibniz's rule over the sub-multisets of S, zw34_recip() the reciprocal from the identity \(A\,(1/A) = 1\) differentiated along S, and the remaining functions are the sum, the difference and the constants. They serve zero_wrapper_d34expected().

Usage

zw34_memo(f)

zw34_subsets(k)

zw34_mul(A, B)

zw34_recip(A)

zw34_add(A, B)

zw34_neg(A)

zw34_const(x)

Arguments

f

A function of S to be memoized.

k

A non-negative integer, the length of S.

A, B

Quantities, as functions of a sorted integer vector.

x

A numeric vector, the value of a constant quantity.

Value

zw34_memo(), zw34_mul(), zw34_recip(), zw34_add(), zw34_neg() and zw34_const() return a function of S; zw34_subsets() returns a list of logical vectors of length k, one per sub-multiset.
